title: R. Fowler British P. H. D. Inspector - Anti-British Attitude

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 425 (C)
C.S. 6, Special Branch // Stafford, 40
REPORT
Date July 11, 19 40.
Subject R. Fowler (British), P.H.D. Inspector - Anti-British attitude.
Made by D.S. Mischenko Forwarded by

Mr. R. Fowler, British, Health Inspector, of the
Public Health Department, S.M.C., residing in a
boarding house at Lane 1220, House 1, Avenue Road,
has come to the notice of the undersigned as being a
person whose ill-digested opinions, based mainly on
communistic and anti-British propaganda, are liable
to cause a disturbing influence, most undesirable,
in view of the recent political events. A hot-
headed extremist and a permanent subscriber to the
Lloyd
"Ostasiatischer", R. Fowler fosters communism in his
conversations with boarders of various nationalities
living on the premises.

This report, submitted by the undersigned, who is
also residing on the premises, is not based on one
specific instance, but is the result of continuous
observation during the course of some eight months
of his residence in the above boarding house. It
should be mentioned here that despite the most recent
anti-British outbursts made by R. Fowler, following
the recent capitulation of France, his opinions are
accepted with disgust by the German-Jewish, American,
British and Czechoslovakian tenants, the majority of
whom refrain from entering into political conversations.

There is little doubt that R. Fowler's debates
would meet with a hostile feeling elsewhere, in view of
which this report is submitted for information.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER DIVISIONS 11 JUL 1940）

FILE

D.C.(Special Branch)
S. Mischenko.
D. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 425 (C)
中央巡捕房，特科 // 斯塔福德，40号
报告
日期：1940年7月11日。
事由：R. Fowler（英国人），公共卫生督察员——反英态度。
呈报人：D.S. Mischenko 转呈

R. Fowler 先生，英国人，系上海公共租界工部局公共卫生处卫生督察员，现居住于爱文义路（Avenue Road）1220弄1号的一家寄宿公寓内。此人已进入具名呈报人的视线，其言论基于共产主义及反英宣传，且未经深思熟虑，鉴于近期的政治事件，此类言论极易造成令人极为不快的扰乱性影响。作为一名头脑发热的极端分子，以及德文报纸《Ostasiatischer》（音译）的长期订阅者，R. Fowler 在与该住所内各国籍的寄宿者交谈时宣扬共产主义。

本报告由同样居住在该住所内的具名呈报人提交，并非基于某一特定事件，而是对其在上述寄宿公寓居住约八个月期间持续观察的结果。此处需提及，尽管 R. Fowler 在法国最近投降后发表了激烈的反英言论，但德裔犹太人、美国人、英国人及捷克斯洛伐克人租户均厌恶地看待其观点，其中大多数人避免参与政治谈话。

毫无疑问，R. Fowler 的辩论若在其他地方进行，将会遭遇敌对情绪，有鉴于此，特提交本报告以供知悉。

（印：副警务总监 各分区 1940年7月11日）

存档

副警务总监（特科）
S. Mischenko.
D. S.
